errors.evidence: The months on the x-axis are arranged in chronological order (I, II, III...), not alphabetical order as stated. The phrase 'in alphabetical order by time sequence' is contradictory and incorrect.
The legend is located in the bottom right corner of the chart, not the top right corner.

errors.text_span: най-ниските стойности са в 2023 г. през месец VIII
errors.evidence: The description identifies month VIII (August) as having the lowest values for 2023. Visually, the values for month VII (July) and month XII (December) in 2023 are equally low, all hovering just above 80,000. Singling out only month VIII is an oversimplification.
The description states the value for month VIII in 2023 is 'under 80,000'. The bar for this data point is visibly slightly above the 80,000 grid line.
